special_encounters.note: The farm stops for a human on a wild shiny. The simulator cannot wait, so catch is off: fight with the normal move rules and do not make a special shiny catch.
Catch when a party slot is empty, shields are down, and the enemy BST is above the weakest party member. Ball cap rogue means the best non-Master ball.
Trainers are fought like a normal wave. No catch.
The Classic final boss is never a catch target.
